organizations.csv: Key quality: acct_num (designated key) has 13 nulls and 18 duplicates; these will need remediation at validation to satisfy organization_id uniqueness.

company_status will be overridden to inactive for dormant accounts per Rule 2 using last_activity_date relative to migration cutover date; 5 future-dated last_activity_date values exist and will be ignored for dormancy.
On Hold accounts will migrate as lifecycle_status=active per Rule 6; the temporary billing pause state is not modeled in the catalog and will not be preserved.

primary_contact_email: 39 malformed values and 102 upper-case values were reported; we will lowercase all and surface invalids during validation. Creating contacts from this field will require generating contact.contact_id and supplying contact.first_name/last_name; these will be addressed in contact load design.

country normalization applies Rule 5: 'CA' disambiguation uses created_on and hq_state; when country is blank we attempt to infer from hq_state; remaining blanks will be flagged at validation because organization.billing_country is required.
created_on and last_activity_date contain a handful of future dates (4 and 5 respectively); please review as they can affect customer_since loading (if approved) and dormancy classification.
industry_code mapping assumes '31' => manufacturing and '23' => construction (likely NAICS top-level); if different, provide the intended mapping.

customer_tier mapping to organization.account_priority needs a decision (see question). Strategic accounts also imply Enterprise subscriptions per Rule 4; that linkage will be handled in subscription migration, not via this field.
website: 216 URLs lack a scheme and 94 placeholders (e.g., N/A); we will prepend https:// when missing and null-out placeholders.
contacts.csv: 22 contacts have null acct_num and cannot be loaded because contact.organization_id is required and must reference an existing organization; these will need backfilling or exclusion at validation.
106 emails in 'contact_mail' are malformed per profiling; these rows will fail email format validation unless corrected during cleansing.
Phone numbers require E.164; 88 are too short per profiling. Default country code choice (awaiting customer answer) will affect how many can be normalized.

Applying Rule 13 to infer is_primary from role when the explicit flag is blank may create more than one primary per organization; cross-record validation will catch this and a tie-break (e.g., account-level primary_contact_email per Rule 1) may be needed.
The 'full_name' split assumes two or more tokens with the first token as first_name and the remainder as last_name; names with unexpected formats (prefixes/suffixes) may need manual cleanup.

We assume 'acct_num' values correspond exactly to organization.organization_id from the organizations import; if the organizations dataset transforms or pads these IDs, the same normalization must be applied here to maintain referential integrity.
'last_touch' includes 8 future dates per profiling; this field is not migrated, so they will be ignored.
subscriptions.json: Rule #11: Trial subscriptions older than 90 days should not be migrated. Implementation should filter out rows where status is trial/trialing or subscription_level == 'Trial' and start_dt is more than 90 days before the migration cutoff.
subscription.seats is required but seat_count is null in 4.1% of rows; defaults or remediation will be decided at validation.
subscription.start_date and subscription.renewal_date are required but have 9 and 16 nulls respectively; remediation strategy is a validation step.
25 rows with billing_freq 'Q' will be converted to monthly per rule #9.
75 rows have currency CAD; their amounts will be loaded into mrr_usd without conversion per rule #12 (finance to true up post go-live).
Two start_dt values are in the future; 80 renewal dates are in the future. These are acceptable but will be validated; renewal_date must be after start_date per schema.
Mapping 'Legacy Gold' to plan depends on seat_count per rule #7; where seat_count is missing, handling will be addressed during validation.

Cross-entity consistency: If an organization is later imported as strategic (organization.account_priority == 'strategic'), its subscriptions must be enterprise per rule #4; reconcile during end-to-end validation.
acct_num is 90% unique, implying some organizations have multiple subscriptions, which is acceptable; ensure referenced organizations are preloaded (target cross-record rule).
activity.csv: Assumption: acct_num is the same identifier that will populate organization.organization_id in the organizations load. If a different org key is chosen, a lookup table will be required to translate acct_num -> organization_id for activities.
Load order: ensure organizations are created before activities (cross-record rule).
activity_type contains both "Support Ticket" and "Ticket"; we proposed mapping "Ticket" to support_ticket, but this needs confirmation along with how to handle "Call".
occurred_at includes multiple formats and some future timestamps (up to 2026-09-11). Future-dated activities are noted for validation but do not affect mapping.
amount contains ~650 placeholders that will be set to null, and some values with symbols/separators that will be normalized during parsing.
